description:
## Problem (observed by the contract-test author; reproduced against fakes, not a real Synapse workspace)
`SynapseSparkAdapter.apply_unified_tuning(unified_config)` takes one argument. The base setup phase calls `apply_unified_tuning(config, connection)`. With tuning enabled the call raises `TypeError`.

## Change
- Align the signature with the base method (`unified_config, connection`) and check the other cloud Spark adapters (EMR Serverless, Dataproc Serverless, Fabric Spark, Athena Spark, Glue, Quanton) for the same drift.
- Add a signature-conformance test over every adapter's `apply_unified_tuning` against the base method.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No live cloud runs without explicit approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
